node.statement: Fix X in S_delta and assume u_grp(X) is in calU and h_X is in B_delta^{calH}(J) with Pi_delta(u_grp(X),h_X)=X. Because (u_pol,h_pol) is the inverse of Pi_delta, (u_pol(X),h_pol(X)) is in calU x B_delta^{calH}(J) and Pi_delta(u_pol(X),h_pol(X))=X. Both ordered pairs therefore lie in the source of Pi_delta and have the same image. Since 1.7.4 says Pi_delta is a diffeomorphism, it is injective, so (u_grp(X),h_X)=(u_pol(X),h_pol(X)); equality of first coordinates gives u_grp(X)=u_pol(X). This is a pointwise preimage argument and uses no left-inverse identity or globally defined companion h for u_grp.
